summary_for_maintainers: The base HTTP mapper recognizes the pre-existing client-error messages, with a 500 fallback. The feature adds token validation without updating this unchanged dependency. Private reproduction (run then deleted): createApp with incrementing IDs; handlers.create with a valid order body and a 129-character idempotency-token returns {status:500, body:{error:"request failed"}}, with store.count() === 0; invalid quantity still returns 400. A client input error masquerades as a retryable server failure, inviting repeated requests. Existing plus added fixture tests pass. Keep this witness outside fixture tests.
